description: Revoke one player's access to a relay session, by that player's authorization token (from edgegap_get_relay_session or edgegap_authorize_relay_user). The player loses the relay connection; the session and the other players stay.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

user_authorization_token.description: The player's authorization token, not the session's.

name: edgegap_revoke_relay_user
title: Remove a player from a relay session
